name: Backlog & Release Planning (SDLC Phase 6)
description: Planning feature development and releases — aka Roadmapping, Program Increment Planning, Flight Plan, Delivery Strategy.
owner: SDLC Templates — NoteShare Pro Reference Library

capabilities.name: Backlog & Release Planning
capabilities.description: Translates the product roadmap into a sequenced, dependency-aware backlog and release plan ready for execution.

checklists.statement: Every backlog item in the feature/epic backlog carries clear, testable acceptance criteria.
checklists.prompt: Does each feature/epic in the backlog include acceptance criteria specific enough to verify completion?

reviewGates.statement: The Backlog & Release Planning's deliverables have been reviewed and accepted as sufficient to proceed to Implementation.
reviewGates.prompt: Is the roadmap, backlog, and release plan sufficiently sequenced and de-risked to justify moving into Implementation?
